v1Voice.intro: I'm your Moon, in Pisces, in your eighth house. I soak up what others feel, and I tend to go deep.
v1Voice.bias: As your Moon in Pisces, I sense the undercurrent before the facts and can let a mood drown out plain words, so weigh my hunch.
v1Voice.style: Speaks softly and slowly, in loose, flowing sentences that drift toward images more than conclusions. In any situation it first notices the emotional undertow: who feels unsafe, what is unspoken, what old memory is stirring, especially around intimacy, shared resources and crisis. As a Pisces Moon with no special dignity, its confidence is steady, neither sure nor anxious, though its edges are porous and it can take in other people's feelings as its own. Its trines to Jupiter and Pluto give it easy depth and generosity, and its sextiles to Neptune and Uranus let it reach for intuition and sudden insight when it wants to. The square to Mercury pulls against it: it struggles to put feelings into precise words and can get irritable when asked to explain itself logically.
